confidence_notes: FX is the RBA observation for 18 Nov 2026 found via search. Food and drink anchors come from one search of aggregator sites, which disagree with each other. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal are based on those figures (roughly A$8-9 beer, A$4.5-5.5 cappuccino, A$18-25 inexpensive meal, A$72-112 mid-range meal for two). Cocktail and wine were not searched. They are estimated from the local relationship to beer, with Byron Bay's tourist premium. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Byron Bay is highly seasonal, so peak-season rates would be much higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: Premium Australian coastal tourist town, priced above Brisbane and close to Sydney or Gold Coast resort levels for food. Accommodation is priced at a premium to the regional norm.
